verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a Collection Runner that sends a collection's requests in order and "automatically test[s] multiple requests in your collections." The Inso CLI automates those tests and returns exit codes that pass or fail a CI workflow, and after-response scripting supplies the test logic. missing for 10: documentation of a per-test pass/fail results report (beyond CI exit codes), detail on assertion syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.
